---
title: "Slaapscore vs Hartslag — Analyse"
author: "Robin Offringa"
output: html_document
---


## 1. Libraries laden

```{r libraries}
library(ggplot2)
```

---

## 2. Data inladen

```{r data-laden}
sleep_data     <- read.csv("/Users/robinoffringa/Desktop/De-Wetenschappelijke-Cyclus/takeout_robin/Fitbit/Sleep Score/sleep_score.csv")
heartrate_data <- read.csv("/Users/robinoffringa/Desktop/De-Wetenschappelijke-Cyclus/takeout_robin/Fitbit/average_heart_rate_excluding_sleep.csv")
```

---

## 3. Data voorbereiden & samenvoegen

```{r data-prep}
# Datumkolommen omzetten
sleep_data$date     <- as.Date(sleep_data$timestamp)
heartrate_data$date <- as.Date(heartrate_data$date)

# Merge op datum
data <- merge(
  sleep_data[, c("date", "overall_score", "resting_heart_rate")],
  heartrate_data[, c("date", "average_heart_rate", "total_steps")],
  by = "date"
)

# Verwijder rijen met ontbrekende waarden
data <- data[complete.cases(data), ]

cat("Data punten: n =", nrow(data), "\n")
```

---

## 4. Statistieken

```{r statistieken}
cat("Slaapscore       — Mean:", round(mean(data$overall_score), 2),
    ", SD:", round(sd(data$overall_score), 2), "\n")

cat("Hartslag overdag — Mean:", round(mean(data$average_heart_rate), 2),
    ", SD:", round(sd(data$average_heart_rate), 2), "\n")

cat("Stappen per dag   — Mean:", round(mean(data$total_steps), 2),
  ", SD:", round(sd(data$total_steps), 2), "\n")
```

---

## 5. Analyse A — Slaapscore vs Hartslag Overdag

### Correlatie

```{r correlatie-hartslag}
model_hr <- lm(overall_score ~ average_heart_rate, data = data)
sum_hr <- summary(model_hr)
corr <- cor.test(data$overall_score, data$average_heart_rate, alternative = "two.sided")
cat("R^2 =", round(sum_hr$r.squared, 3), ", p (cor.test) =", round(corr$p.value, 3), "\n")
```

### Plot

```{r plot-hartslag, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
ggplot(data, aes(x = average_heart_rate, y = overall_score)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, color = "blue", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "Slaapscore vs Hartslag Overdag",
    x     = "Gemiddelde Hartslag (bpm)",
    y     = "Slaapscore"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

---

## 6. Analyse B — Slaapscore vs Rusthartslag

### Correlatie

```{r correlatie-rusthartslag}
model_rest <- lm(overall_score ~ resting_heart_rate, data = data)
sum_rest <- summary(model_rest)
corr2 <- cor.test(data$overall_score, data$resting_heart_rate, alternative = "two.sided")
cat("R^2 =", round(sum_rest$r.squared, 3), ", p (cor.test) =", round(corr2$p.value, 3), "\n")
```

### Plot

```{r plot-rusthartslag, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
ggplot(data, aes(x = resting_heart_rate, y = overall_score)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, color = "darkgreen", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "Slaapscore vs Rusthartslag",
    x     = "Rusthartslag (bpm)",
    y     = "Slaapscore"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

---

## 7. Analyse C — Slaapscore vs Stappen per dag

### Correlatie

```{r correlatie-stappen}
model_steps <- lm(overall_score ~ total_steps, data = data)
sum_steps <- summary(model_steps)
corr3 <- cor.test(data$overall_score, data$total_steps, alternative = "two.sided")
cat("R^2 =", round(sum_steps$r.squared, 3), ", p (cor.test) =", round(corr3$p.value, 3), "\n")
```

### Plot

```{r plot-stappen, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
ggplot(data, aes(x = total_steps, y = overall_score)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, color = "orange", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "Slaapscore vs Stappen per dag",
    x     = "Stappen per dag",
    y     = "Slaapscore"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## 8. Alle variabelen samen meerdere dimensies bekijken

### Correlaties

```{r^2 correlaties-overzicht}
model_all <- lm(overall_score ~ average_heart_rate + resting_heart_rate + total_steps, data = data)
sum_all <- summary(model_all)
cat("R^2 =", round(sum_all$r.squared, 3), ", p (model) =", round(sum_all$fstatistic[1], 3), "\n")
```
